chapter: Faith, Paris life and later years
title: Why his marriage to Carmen McRae ended
summary: Dance recalls the breakup: Carmen was going to be a star and Clarke was not the sort to accompany her; they remain close and he is now married 21 years.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Meeting, courting and marrying: musicians' love lives
